meta.positive_class: is_fraud == 1 (fraudulent); every precision/recall/F1 is for the fraud class
protocol: Test rows are never used for tuning, threshold choice or model selection.
Hyper-parameters tuned with 5-fold stratified CV on training rows only.
Scaler is inside a Pipeline, so it is fit on training folds only.
Thresholds chosen on out-of-fold validation predictions.
Test metrics computed once per model after every choice was fixed.
meta.search_criterion: F1 of the fraud class (precision and recall also recorded)

threshold_rules.youden: maximises validation recall + specificity - 1 (secondary, class-balance aware)

meta.selection_rule: highest validation F1 at the model's f1_opt threshold; differences <= 0.001 are ties resolved toward the simpler model (original LR, then tuned LR, then Random Forest)
meta.synthetic_data_note: The dataset is synthetic. generate_data.py draws each label from a hand-written logistic formula of the same seven features, with no intercept, so ~88% of rows are fraud. High scores measure how well a model re-learns that formula, not how well it would detect real UPI fraud.
